page.layout: One page of text, all centred, no margins: dedication heading in large type at top, small centred paragraph beneath, spaced-capital line "NEC NON,", a second dedication in large type, then a short italic dedication line and the signature line at lower right.

main_text.head: Eruditione ac pietate Clarissimis Viris, D. JOHANNI RODOLPHO WIRZIO, D. JOHANNI WIRZIO,
main_text.p: Illi in Ecclesia{1} quæ Wislingæ, huic in ea quæ Bussingæ colligitur, Pastoribus disertissimis Avunculis suis colendis, honorandis.
main_text.head: NEC NON,
main_text.p: Doctissimo, Celeberrimoque Viro, D. HERMANNO AMIÆ, Pastori in Ecclesia Lugd. Batav. vigilantissimo, fidelissimo, Fautori suo summopere suspiciendo.
Hasce theses Philosophicas In debitæ observantiæ πκμήελον[?] offert & inscribit

page.notes: The Greek word after "observantiæ" is doubtful; the letters read as πκμήελον and may be misprinted or misread. A small superscript "1" stands above the line at "Ecclesia" and a second small mark sits at the start of "Bussingæ"; no matching note is printed, so the reference mark is given once at "Ecclesia". The line "offert & inscribit" is set in the same italic as the preceding line and has been split from it for layout. Faint mirrored show-through from the reverse side appears behind the upper right and lower centre and is not transcribed. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.
